pipeline.title: Rhythm doubles down on LG obesity license, raising payout to as much as $855M
pipeline.summary: Rhythm Pharmaceuticals and LG Chem have rewritten the terms of their licensing agreement for the oral obesity and hyperphagia drug bivamelagon, growing to $855 million in scheduled payments from the earlier milestone-based deal of $305 million.

pipeline.title: AbbVie abandons phase 2 solid tumor drug over ‘limited benefit’
pipeline.summary: AbbVie has scrapped a phase 2 solid tumor drug after deciding that the monoclonal antibody was unlikely to best the current standard of care, Fierce has learned.

pipeline.title: Pfizer pares back obesity pipeline, drops phase 2-stage lung disease candidate
pipeline.summary: Pfizer has axed a phase 2 pulmonary arterial hypertension program on business grounds, dealing a setback to a long-running effort to treat the lung disease by targeting BMP9.

pipeline.title: FDA grants uniQure’s Huntington’s gene therapy priority review, teeing up ‘defining milestone’
pipeline.summary: The FDA has accepted uniQure’s priority review and application for its gene therapy treatment for Huntington’s disease.

pipeline.title: Inovio’s DNA-based immunotherapy Voceryq approved by FDA for rare HPV airway disease
pipeline.summary: After an initial FDA scare that threatened its path for an accelerated approval, Inovio’s Voceryq, the first plasmid DNA-based immunotherapy, has earned a go-ahead to treat a rare HPV-driven disease.

pipeline.title: Lower dose of Tiziana's MS drug reduces neuroinflammation, while higher dose struggles
pipeline.summary: Tiziana Life Sciences’ intranasal drug has hit the dual endpoints of a phase 2a study in patients with a form of multiple sclerosis (MS), although the win was slightly marred by the higher dose missing a key neuroinflammation goal.

pipeline.title: China's InventisBio delivers competitive TYK2 data in phase 3 psoriasis win
pipeline.summary: A phase 3 trial of InventisBio’s nomelcitinib has hit its primary endpoint, delivering evidence that the TYK2 inhibitor can hold its own against rival psoriasis drugs.

pipeline.title: Chutes & Ladders—Lilly unifies global markets as 36-year vet Patrik Jonsson retires
pipeline.summary: Lilly will unite its U.S. and international commercial units as a long-time exec retires. Enanta's CEO will hang up his hat after 23 year at the helm. Estrella has tapped a new a CEO to lead it through a clinical trial.

pipeline.title: How advanced AI can improve clinical trial decision-making
pipeline.summary: Life science foundation models can help teams anticipate patient outcomes and pressure-test trial designs.

pipeline.title: Amgen's quality chief to retire as internal successor steps up
pipeline.summary: Jackie Elbonne, Ph.D., announced her retirement after 35 years in the biopharma industry, leaving Amgen's chief quality officer role to her deputy, Aine Hanly, Ph.D.

pipeline.title: Madrigal’s Rezdiffra storms past blockbuster milestone as CEO hails ‘accelerating’ MASH market
pipeline.summary: To Madrigal CEO Bill Sibold, “it’s hard to find a more attractive growth opportunity in biotech” than MASH, as the company’s Rezdiffra, the first FDA-approved MASH therapy, crossed the $1 billion mark in annual sales.

pipeline.title: Vertex, ahead of FDA decision, calms fears surrounding kidney drug
pipeline.summary: On a conference call, executives expressed conviction in the coming launch of an IgA nephropathy medicine viewed by Wall Street investors as important to Vertex’s future.
